- **Arianne:** Simone Biles is the most decorated gymnast in history. Her full name is Simone **Arianne** Biles, according to [BlackPast](https://blackpast.org/african-american-history/biles-simone-arianne-1997), and [Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/biography/Simone-Biles) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simone_Biles) agree.
- **Kathleen:** Katie Ledecky held the 800 m freestyle world record on July 1, 2024. It was 8:04.79, set at the 2016 Rio Olympics, and she later broke it herself in 2025 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/44987318/katie-ledecky-breaks-own-world-record-800-meter-freestyle)). The searches didn't return her full first name. "Kathleen" comes from my own knowledge that her full name is Kathleen Genevieve Ledecky, so check it against an official profile if it matters.
